2609.11262.title: AI-Powered Flare Combustion Efficiency Estimation
2609.11262.paper_summary: Achieving high combustion efficiency in flare stacks is crucial for adhering to regulatory standards and controlling the release of hydrocarbons into the environment. Traditional instruments like gas analyzers and hyperspectral cameras are expensive, fragile, and require frequent calibration, which makes them impractical for remote or budget constrained industrial sites. We propose an innovative solution that combines a lightweight vision-language encoder with a compact multi-layer perceptron to predict combustion efficiency directly from low-cost thermal video footage. The fully trained model is integrated into an easy-to-deploy graphical user interface. This interface overlays predicted combustion efficiency values on each video frame, displays real-time trends in combustion efficiency, shows the distribution of combustion efficiency across all frames in the video, and allows users to export CSV reports. Over a six-month period, the system achieved 99% uptime and required less than 15 minutes of maintenance per week.
2609.11262.paper_summary_zh: 達成高燃燒效率在火炬堆中對於遵守法規標準和控制碳氫化合物排放到環境中至關重要。傳統儀器如氣體分析儀和高光譜相機價格昂貴、易碎，且需要頻繁校準，這使得它們在偏遠或預算有限的工業現場變得不切實際。我們提出了一種創新的解決方案，將輕量級的視覺-語言編碼器與緊湊的多層感知器結合，以便直接從低成本的熱視頻錄像中預測燃燒效率。經過全面訓練的模型集成到一個易於部署的圖形用戶界面中。該界面在每個視頻幀上疊加預測的燃燒效率值，顯示燃燒效率的實時趨勢，顯示視頻中所有幀的燃燒效率分佈，並允許用戶導出CSV報告。在六個月的時間內，該系統實現了99%的正常運行時間，每週維護時間少於15分鐘。
